content.user_title: Draft Belgian Vehicle Sales and Warranty Documents
content.value_statement: Belgian garages need consistent sales paperwork, mileage procedures, and warranty correspondence. This guide helps an AI assistant draft these materials for independent legal and operational review.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting of Belgian B2C and B2B vehicle order forms, including a short used-car sales example.
Outlines workshop procedures for recording mileage and repair descriptions for Car-Pass reporting.
Guides creation of used-car intake checklists covering damage history and outstanding financing checks.
Supports drafting warranty acceptance and rejection correspondence for review.
Identifies inspection certificate and registration validity as topics requiring current Flemish regulatory verification.
limitations: Only a public SKILL.md guide is included; original scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
No Car-Pass integration, automatic reporting, or executable inspection-date calculation logic is included.
Legal validity, warranty terms, and inspection reforms require verification against current official sources.
The guide does not provide financial advice for specific credit or leasing contracts.

use_cases.title: Prepare a used-car order form
use_cases.description: Draft a vehicle order form from supplied buyer, seller, and vehicle details, marking missing information and legal terms for review.

use_cases.title: Standardize workshop mileage records
use_cases.description: Create a workshop checklist for collecting mileage and repair descriptions before staff submit information through their existing Car-Pass process.

use_cases.title: Prepare warranty correspondence
use_cases.description: Draft a customer response from documented claim facts, separating technical observations from legal conclusions requiring approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create an intake checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Belgian used-car trade-in checklist covering vehicle identity, mileage, damage history, and outstanding financing. Mark information the seller must supply.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: preparing a vehicle intake appointment.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a vehicle order form
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Belgian B2C order form using these details: [seller, buyer, vehicle, mileage, price, delivery]. Flag missing facts and warranty terms for legal review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: preparing a used-car sales document.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a warranty response
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a warranty response using [claim facts, diagnosis, sale date, contract terms]. Separate evidence from assumptions. Flag legal conclusions for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: responding to a documented customer claim.

prompt_templates.title: Review a workshop reporting procedure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [workshop procedure] against [current official Car-Pass guidance]. Propose record fields, responsibilities, and verification steps. Identify unresolved requirements without submitting reports.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: standardizing workshop records using supplied official guidance.

output_examples.input: Draft an order form outline for a 2021 Volkswagen Golf with 85,000 km. Buyer, price, and delivery details are not available.
output: Vehicle: Volkswagen Golf, first registered in 2021; recorded mileage: 85,000 km.
Missing details: seller identity, buyer identity, VIN, price, and delivery date.
Review items: applicable warranty terms, required disclosures, and Car-Pass documentation.
Status: draft outline only; not ready for signature.

output_examples.input: Create an intake checklist for a private trade-in with uncertain damage history.
output: Record seller identity, VIN, registration details, and current mileage.
Request available maintenance records and details of previous repairs or accidents.
Record visible damage and distinguish observations from unverified seller statements.
Check ownership and outstanding financing before approving the purchase.

best_practices: Supply complete vehicle and transaction details, and use explicit placeholders for missing facts.
Verify current warranty, Car-Pass, and inspection requirements through official sources before approving documents.
Have qualified staff review sales terms and warranty decisions before signing or sending correspondence.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as guaranteed legal compliance or a substitute for qualified review.
Assuming this guide submits Car-Pass reports or includes the original automation package.
Applying a one-year warranty limitation or rejecting a claim without checking the applicable law and documented facts.

faq.question: What is included in this skill?
faq.answer: A public guide describing automotive documentation workflows and a short sales example. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Does it submit mileage to Car-Pass?
faq.answer: No Car-Pass submission integration is included. It can guide preparation of workshop procedures and records for your existing reporting process.

faq.question: Are its sales documents guaranteed legally valid?
faq.answer: No. Generated documents need current legal verification and review of the specific transaction before use.

faq.question: Can it help with used-car warranty claims?
faq.answer: It can guide draft acceptance or rejection correspondence. Staff must verify claim facts, contract terms, and applicable consumer protection rules.

faq.question: Does it verify inspection reforms automatically?
faq.answer: No automatic verification is included. The guide explicitly asks users to confirm the September 2026 inspection reforms through official channels such as GOCA.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report lists all three as supported tools. The skill supplies text guidance rather than a platform-specific executable integration.
